assertions.assertion: CPT 93226 is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The patient presents with persistent palpitations and a history of symptomatic bradycardia consistent with sick sinus syndrome

A 48-hour Holter monitor was ordered to further characterize the underlying cardiac arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances during continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic evaluation
The supporting diagnosis codes are I49.5, I49.9, and R00.2
